review_scope: Technical comparison of all 23 current captures to the published baseline, with full-resolution checks of the roof drive, mail bank and signal terminal. Installed guard support and contact were verified in the separate stair receipt.

images.observation: Floor grain, table finish and the adjacent passage resolve under the existing warm pool of light.
The bath tile bands, curtain weave and companion light remain legible in the reflection station.
Floor boards, wall finishes and furnishings hold their surface separation through the resident view.
The floor run, wall tone and window reveal remain continuous around the desk and shelving.
The diffuse light falls across the cupboard and worn plaster edges without erasing the finish boundary.
Boiler plates, fittings and the surrounding basement floor retain separate readable surfaces.
Shelf planes, the back panel and the neighbouring door retain their face and trim definition.
Tile joints continue into the corner around the exposed vertical service and WC.
The dark brick test still resolves individual faces and mortar lines.
The open cover, fuse faces and wall recess remain individually legible. The cover is darker at the capture instant.
Judge and the blanket retain their placement behind the brass footrail. The dim floor and rail finishes match the reference view.
The cat remains distinguishable against the shelf and muted wall.
The shelf and bracket edges retain definition in the standing view.
Brass faceplates, recessed compartments, dark wood and floor finish all resolve. Some compartments are seen in a different open or closed pose.
The radiator ribs, window trim and desk edge remain distinct at the service station.
The added rail spans the visible roof stair edge. Its dark uprights, timber grip and cast shadows resolve against the landing without obscuring the drive enclosure.
The tank, supports and roof surfaces are consistent with the exterior reference.
The terminal body, glass guard, board, floor finish and indicator light read separately.
The tile pattern retains its continuity into the corner behind the fitted service.
The flowing residue remains separate from the floor grain and radiator under the companion beam.
The installed tentacle and the adjacent radiator and floor finishes retain their separate silhouettes and material detail.
The toaster face, crumb tray, kettle and shelf surface remain readable in grazing light.
The station plate and surrounding wall remain distinct in low light.
